## Appearance

Harrison is a short, fat, and bald man with a round face and prominent blue eyes. His appearance is also described as neat and snug.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P11](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0011), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P8](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0008)_

## Personality

Harrison is an outspoken and crusty individual who prides himself on his plain-spoken honesty, earning him a local reputation as a crank. Despite his crabbed and lonesome demeanor, he reveals an outwardly sympathetic and kind nature to those around him. He routinely smokes a pipe on his veranda and holds a strong personal prejudice against marriage.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P25](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0025), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P49](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0049), [v2 IV Different Opinions P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P56](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0056), [v2 IX A Question of Color P40](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0040), +2 more_

## History

After moving to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), Harrison first met [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) when he furiously confronted her over her cow breaking into his oats. Their rocky start was soon resolved when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally sold his Jersey cow and came to apologize, after which Harrison accepted her cake and invited her to tea. Although he developed a warm friendship with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), he remained skeptical of her gentle teaching methods and flatly refused to contribute to her Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers). Later, a devastating hail storm struck the village, leaving Harrison grieving the loss of his beloved parrot, [Ginger](../character/ginger.md). His life was upended again when his estranged wife, [Emily](../character/emily.md), unexpectedly arrived in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea); Harrison confessed to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that they had previously separated over household arguments and [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), but he admitted he was glad to reconcile with her. Following their reunion, Harrison remained a regular part of Anne's life, hosting her for visits prior to local events like Miss Lavendar's wedding.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P14](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0014), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P17](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0017), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P21](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0021), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P24](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0024), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P30](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0030), +431 more_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--harrison.md)

Harrison and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) initially met under tense circumstances when he furiously confronted her over a runaway cow, but their relationship quickly transformed into a good friendship. After [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally sold Harrison's Jersey cow by mistake and offered a cake in apology, he took the error in good humor and invited her to tea. Although he occasionally doubts her gentle teaching philosophy and refuses her requests for local causes like the [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), they maintain a warm bond where they regularly drop by to visit and discuss neighborhood matters.

- Friend of — good friends  <sub>[v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P39](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0039), [v2 IV Different Opinions P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P45](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0045)</sub>

### [Emily](../character/emily.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/emily--harrison.md)

[Emily](../character/emily.md) is Harrison's wife, who unexpectedly arrived in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) three years after their past separation. The two had originally split up due to continuous arguments regarding housecleaning, grammar, and Harrison's swearing parrot, [Ginger](../character/ginger.md). Upon her arrival, they successfully reconciled, with Harrison sheepishly admitting his happiness over her return while [Emily](../character/emily.md) expressed her joy at being back with her husband.

- Spouse of — married three years ago  <sub>[v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P4](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0004)</sub>
